design: TF-IDF retrieval of3 prior MedQA training examples, excluding evaluation/development texts. Static source workflow and3x1536output. No extra LLM call. Only long-option inputs.
gate: Strictly beat static99/120 proposal then static guard120, no invalid increase. No RxQA test if fail.
training_budget_difference: Uses additional external training examples; this is not an equal-training-data comparison with named agents.
motivation: Generic medical factual confusions persisted after full-context and contrastive-review candidates each tied99/120. No RxQA per-item errors used.
